source_note: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0
english_source_note: Zero Integral on Every Measurable Set Implies Vanishing a.e.
callout_id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#2
statement_en: Prove in the same way that for every $\varepsilon$, the set $C_{\varepsilon}:=\{x\in X:f^{-}>\varepsilon\}$ also has measure zero.
key_techniques: use level sets of the negative part
contradiction via nonzero integral on a positive measure set
prerequisites: positive and negative parts of a function
callout_body: 用同样的方式证明$C_{\varepsilon}:=\{x\in X:f^{-}>\varepsilon\}$对任意$\varepsilon$也是零测度的。
